name: quarantine
description: List incoming deliverables held in quarantine: fixes, scripts and tasks that arrived over file sync from an unverified source or without a signature and are not applied until the owner decides. Fail-closed by design. Triggers: "/quarantine", "what is quarantined", or a deploy check reporting held items.
